title: 第11章 蚁军初成第12章 火鸦
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
经过不断的吞并，蚁军渐渐步入正轨，老牌蚁兵也快速成长。
就连飞天蚁，都已经达到五万多，被独立出来，成立了飞蚁军团。雷霆有六十几位成员，也成功进化出了翅膀，一起协助瘦猴带领。他们觉醒了速度光环，也属于狂化的一种，但偏向于速度，唯一欣慰的是理智不会丧失。
雷霆预备队，已经改为重力军团，也是五万编制。由于，力量是蚁族的强项，孙云把一种坚硬的巨木，定为它们的统一武器。在孙云的逼迫下，算是勉强能武出个样来，但还是偏向撕扯和啃咬。
带队的是大牛，十个力量形的老雷霆成员协助，它们觉醒的全是力量狂化。狂化以后，体型能大两倍，力量更是碎石如空气。而且，过后对精神没有副作用，冷却不到十分钟就可以再狂化，简直就是蚁行坦克啊。
而牛犬蚁，作为孙云选择的一个重点蚁种，体型算是最大的蚁种了。在孙云的重点培养下也达到三万多，孙云的求精性格能练出这些，已经算是很不错了。
三万牛犬蚁，被命为绞肉机军团，由牛犬蚁牛弟带领。牛弟自称是大牛的弟弟，脸皮厚到，在牛犬蚁里也是异类了。牛弟觉醒了，类似于蜘蛛丝的技能，但是是透明的，而且更坚韧。在战斗中，只要被这吐丝缠上，几乎难逃牛蚁的巨齿。
再就是军蚁，无处不在的队行，并且绝对的服从命令，简直比军队还军队。孙云定了十五万的编制，战斗力绝对不比其它军团差，而且非常省心。
面对数量巨大，攻守严明军蚁，巨象也得丧命。孙云看着这些军蚁都怕，只要有足够的数量，感觉世界都能铲平啊！
军蚁由性格古板的古特带领，定名为利齿军团。因为，军蚁觉醒的是厉齿，啃咬万物。虽然古特的个人实力，在各大军团长里是最弱的，但没有蚁敢招惹它。它不但只服从孙云，而且不与其它蚁交流，就认一点，孙云的命令。
洪水军团，是孙云的主力团，各大军团损失，也是在洪水军团调度，是一个混杂的军团。孙云收入的各类兵蚁和幼蚁，都要先划入洪水军历练。
洪水军的军团长，是一只红色的蚂蚁，性格残暴、狡猾。它是孙云扫荡一群土匪蚁时，得到的一只普通的幼蚁，竟然也叫红头。
红头把孙云视作唯一的神，其它蚁视如草，除了疯战，没蚁敢得罪他。当然，毕竟都得在它那挑兵，都不想被穿小鞋。有孙云的命令，红头到不敢胡来。
由于红头的残暴，所以洪水军每次损耗都是巨大的，至今没突破四十万。当然，这也是孙云暗许的，毕竟部队要求精。
当然，红头自己的实力，也不弱于其它军团长，没有多少蚂蚁支持的红头，可是靠实力打出来的。他觉醒的吐毒雾可能群战无敌了，连孙云也搞不懂为什么只有红头一只红蚁能觉醒。
红头的手下，觉醒异能也是挺奇怪，会吐刺的，会扔飞石的，千奇百怪的，搞得孙云都迷糊。更郁闷的是，竟然还有一个会装死的，并且搞个急难驯服的穿山甲座骑，这值蚁一天天舒服的，气的孙云直哆嗦。
再一个就是猛蚁了，战斗天赋非常高，好像就是为战斗而生的。矫健的身材可以做任何动作，速度奇快，齿如刀刃一样锋利，每秒闭合达到一万多次。
尤其是队长疯战，在陆地上孙云都不是他对手。觉醒的是分化天赋，可以分出五个小蚁来战斗，分化后对自己实力无任何影响。小蚁的实力和时间随着自身实力增长，主体身死，分蚁可复活。所有蚁都拒绝疯战的挑战，去和打不死的小强斗，找虐的么。
唯一可惜的就是太稀少，近乎灭绝，这也是孙云第二个养了蚁后的蚁群。也是，孙云总共遇到两次猛蚁群，才幸运得到的一只蚁后，自然要珍惜了。
本来就生育低下的猛蚁，要求非常严格，只留下健壮的战斗蚁们和最强壮的生育雄蚁，其它幼蚁全部处死。好斗也使猛蚁死亡率剧增，一百个能有一个才能活到成年，一百个成年才能有一个活到符合疯战的接受，孙云的劝说也改变不了猛蚁的传统。
因为对猛蚁的尊重，近百位成员的猛蚁战队，也被封为冲锋战队，因为他们总是要求冲锋在前面。

雷霆战队，是最早的站队，现在还保持两百，都是各军团选拔的精英，由黑头带领。各项能力也都比较强，实力都有近似军团长的实力。黑头平时受孙云指点和照顾最多，实力仅次于疯战。为蚁忠厚，稳重的黑头，孙云不在的时候他也是蚁军唯一的主心骨。
黑头执着的学习孙云练两只蚁腿走路，令孙云郁闷的是不但成功了，而且还超过了孙云。除了用下面两爪走路，竟然用前面四爪战斗。中间两爪一个拿盾牌，一个拿飞木，前爪不像大牛用的重力巨木，确用的一双削尖的双棍。飞木专挑一些弱点攻击，防不胜防，盾牌与双木的配合，攻防天衣无缝，让最擅长战斗的疯战也头疼不已。
当然黑头也觉醒了天赋，最强防御，使自已的身体任何部位都对攻击免疫。其实在孙云看来有点鸡肋，蚂蚁的身体本来就坚硬，这天赋对群战帮助不大。唯一的感觉就是擅长pK了，打不动可不就气人么。
最后就是孙云的近卫了，这就有点弱爆了。一个红头推荐的巨齿蚁小奇，本来是入选雷霆的，各科项目都合格。但是，却出现了戏剧性的一幕，战斗是合格了，但并没有多大战力。
战力考，是在考官的攻击下是坚持一小时了。小奇的天赋是随意变大小，是坚持一小时了，但根本都没战斗吖！小奇不用天赋的情况下，连个普通的军蚁兵都战不胜。黑头死活都不肯要他，但毕竟合格了，没办法孙云给收了。
一个是雷霆的老成员啊泰，虽然体型已经和大牛差不多，但战力确差远了。尤其天生味觉好的啊泰，天赋竟然是千里寻味。这也注定了，啊泰的资格老，确在雷霆永远垫底的尴尬位置。
就像一个职场员工，一直看着新人一个个成为自己上司，自己确永远原地踏步。这样下去，不但会打击啊泰的自信心，而且也不方便雷霆管理。毕竟其它升迁之后，老指挥自已曾经的职场老师，确实挺尴尬的。孙云再三考虑，还是调到身边了，领导难做啊！
再就是两只烦人的彩翼鸟了，孙云当时的一时心软，就把这两只小鸟养在了身边了。现在除了喷点火，再没看到有什么优点了，重点是不危机生命，绝对不愿意去战斗。用他们的话说，他们是负责美的，尽管确实挺美，但孙云还是想吃鸟肉！
最后是终极boSS孙云了，孙云也成功进化了翅膀，但没有觉醒速度天赋。手持一对不知是什么牙做的刀，综合战力绝对的第一。但是，如果不用翅膀，那就不一定了。当然，孙云也在尝试练飞枪，来提高自己的远战能力。
值得一提的是空间石，又得到十六块，这可是好东西。让孙云失望的是，孙云渐渐的发展，炼化起来越来越慢，很长时间才能炼化一块小的。
孙云没觉醒天赋，但现在行为更像人了，穿上兽皮做的衣服，现在孙云就像三四岁小孩大小的机器人。有时候孙云感觉，天赋和实力都是和努力的方向和想要的那份执着有关系一点点关系。
飞蚁军团，团长瘦猴五万战士；重力军团，团长大牛五万战士；绞肉机军团，团长牛弟三万战士；历齿军军团，团长古特十五万战士；洪水军团，团长红头四十万左右士兵；冲锋军团，疯战与百于战士；雷霆战队，黑头与二百战士；近卫小奇和啊泰，还有俩鸟。
这就是孙云现在的力量了，在这无尽的森林、山脉也勉强可以自保了。现在孙云也不打算过多的增加了，毕竟又不是占山头，过多的增加会影响行军，孙云的目标是寻找文明。
content_en:
After continuous annexation, the ant army gradually got on the right track, and the veteran ant soldiers also grew rapidly.
Even the number of flying ants has reached more than 50,000, and they have been separated and established the flying ant army. Thunder has more than sixty members, and they have also successfully evolved wings, and together they assist Slender Monkey in leading them. They have awakened the speed aura, which is also a type of madness, but they prefer speed. The only comfort is that their sanity will not be lost.
The Thunder Reserve has been changed to the Gravity Corps, also with a strength of 50,000. Since strength is the ant tribe's strength, Sun Yun designated a hard giant tree as their unified weapon. Under Sun Yun's pressure, he was barely able to show off his skills, but he still preferred to tear and bite.
The team is led by Daniel, assisted by ten old thunder members in the form of power. What they have awakened is power madness. After transforming into madness, his body size can be twice as large, and his strength can be as strong as gravel as air. Moreover, it has no side effects on the spirit afterwards, and it can be transformed into madness again in less than ten minutes of cooling. It is simply an ant-walking tank.
As for the bulldog ant, one of the key ant species chosen by Sun Yun, it is considered the largest ant species. Under Sun Yun's focused training, it has reached more than 30,000. Sun Yun's perfection-seeking character can develop these, which is already very good.
Thirty thousand Bulldog Ants were appointed as the Meat Grinder Legion, led by Bulldog Ant Niu Brother. Brother Niu claims to be Daniel's younger brother. He is so thick-skinned that he is an outlier among bulls, dogs and ants. Brother Niu has awakened, a skill similar to spider silk, but it is transparent and tougher. In battle, as long as one is entangled in this silk, it is almost impossible to escape from the bull ant's giant teeth.
Then there are the army ants. They march in formations everywhere and obey orders absolutely. They are simply more of an army than an army. Sun Yun has set an establishment of 150,000, and the combat effectiveness is definitely no worse than other legions, and it is very worry-free.
Faced with a huge number of ants and strict defense and attack, the giant elephant will also die. Sun Yun was scared when he saw these army ants. As long as there were enough of them, it felt like the world could be leveled!
The army ants are led by the old-fashioned Gute and named the Sharp Tooth Army. Because the army ants awaken their sharp teeth and gnaw at everything. Although Gut's personal strength is the weakest among the major army commanders, no ant dares to provoke him. Not only does it only obey Sun Yun, but it also does not communicate with other ants and only recognizes Sun Yun's orders.
The Flood Legion is Sun Yun's main force. The losses of the major legions are also managed by the Flood Legion. It is a mixed legion. All kinds of soldier ants and young ants that Sun Yun collects must first be included in the Flood Army for training.
The commander of the Flood Army is a red ant with a cruel and cunning character. It was an ordinary young ant that Sun Yun got when he wiped out a group of bandit ants. It was also called a red head.
The red head regards Sun Yun as the only god, and other ants regard him as grass. No ant dares to offend him except Mad War. Of course, after all, you have to recruit troops from it, and you don’t want to be stuck in the shoes. With Sun Yun's order, the red head dare not act recklessly.
Due to Red Head's brutality, the Flood Army's losses are huge every time, and it has not exceeded 400,000 so far. Of course, this is what Sun Yun secretly promised, after all, the army requires excellence.
Of course, the red head's own strength is not weaker than that of other legion commanders. The red head does not have much ant support, but he relies on strength. The poisonous mist he awakened may be invincible in a group battle. Even Sun Yun couldn't figure out why only a red ant with a red head could awaken.
The red-headed men's awakened powers were also quite strange. They could spit thorns and throw flying rocks. They were all so strange that they confused Sun Yun. What's even more depressing is that there is actually someone who can pretend to be dead and build a pangolin mount that is difficult to tame. This makes Sun Yun tremble with anger as the ants become more comfortable every day.
The next one is the Fierce Ant, which has a very high fighting talent and seems to be born for fighting. The strong body can perform any movement at an extremely fast speed. The teeth are as sharp as a knife blade and can be closed more than 10,000 times per second.
Especially the captain who fought like crazy, Sun Yun was no match for him on land.What is awakened is the talent of differentiation, which can separate five ants to fight. After differentiation, it will have no impact on one's own strength. The strength and time of the little ants increase with their own strength. If the main body dies, the sub-ants can be resurrected. All the ants refused the challenge of crazy fighting and went to fight with the invincible little gangster, looking for abuse.
The only pity is that it is so rare that it is almost extinct. This is also the second ant colony that Sun Yun has raised a queen. Also, Sun Yun encountered fierce ant colonies twice in total, and was lucky enough to get a queen ant, so he naturally had to cherish it.
The fierce ants, which have low fertility, have very strict requirements. Only the strong fighting ants and the strongest fertile male ants are left, and all other young ants are killed. Aggressiveness also causes the mortality rate of fierce ants to increase dramatically. Only one in a hundred can live to adulthood, and only one in a hundred adults can live to meet the acceptance of mad war. Sun Yun's persuasion cannot change the tradition of fierce ants.
Out of respect for the Fierce Ants, the Fierce Ant Team, which has nearly a hundred members, was also named the Charge Team because they always required to charge at the front.
The Thunder Team was the earliest team, and it still has two hundred members. They are all elites selected by each legion, and are led by Black Head. All abilities are also relatively strong, and their strength is similar to that of a legion commander. Blackhead usually receives the most guidance and care from Sun Yun, and his strength is second only to Mad War. Hei Tou is a loyal and steady figure for the ants. When Sun Yun is away, he is also the only backbone of the ant army.
Heitou persistently learned from Sun Yun to practice walking on two ant legs. What made Sun Yun depressed was that not only did he succeed, but he also surpassed Sun Yun. In addition to walking with the lower two claws, it actually fights with the front four claws. One of the two middle claws holds a shield, and the other holds flying wood. The front claws are not like the giant gravity wood used by Daniel, but are indeed a pair of sharpened sticks. Feimu specially selects some weak points to attack, making it impossible to defend against. The combination of the shield and the double wood makes the attack and defense seamless, giving even Crazy Zhan, who is best at fighting, a headache.
Of course, Blackhead also awakened his talent, the strongest defense, making any part of his body immune to attacks. In fact, in Sun Yun's opinion, it's a bit useless. The body of ants is inherently tough, so this talent is of little help in group battles. The only feeling is that if you are good at pK, wouldn't it be annoying if you can't beat it?
Finally, there is Sun Yun's close guard, which is a bit weak. A giant-toothed ant Xiaoqi recommended by a red head was originally selected for the Thunder and was qualified in all subjects. However, a dramatic scene occurred. The battle was passable, but it did not have much fighting power.
The combat prowess test is to persist for one hour under the attack of the examiner. Xiaoqi's talent is to change the size at will. He persisted for an hour, but he didn't fight at all! Xiaoqi can't even defeat an ordinary army ant soldier without using any talent. Heitou refused to take him life and death, but after all, he was qualified, so Sun Yun had no choice but to accept him.
One is Tai, an old member of the Thunder. Although his size is similar to that of Daniel, his combat power is far behind. Especially Ah Tai, who was born with a good sense of taste, but his talent is Qianli Xunwei. It is also destined that Ah Tai's seniority will always put him in the awkward position of the bottom of the Thunder.
Just like an employee in the workplace, he has been watching new people become his boss one by one, and he has always stayed in the same place. If this continues, it will not only damage Ah Tai's self-confidence, but also make it inconvenient for the Thunder to manage. After all, after other promotions, the old conductor was indeed quite embarrassed by his former workplace teacher. Sun Yun thought twice and decided to transfer him to his side. It's hard to be a leader!
Then there were the two annoying colorful-winged birds. Sun Yun felt soft-hearted and kept these two little birds by his side. Now apart from spraying fire, I don't see any advantages anymore. The key point is not to endanger lives, and I am absolutely unwilling to fight. In their words, they are responsible for beauty. Although it is indeed beautiful, Sun Yun still wants to eat bird meat!
Finally, there is the ultimate boss Sun Yun. Sun Yun also successfully evolved wings, but did not awaken the speed talent. Holding a pair of swords made of unknown teeth, the overall combat power is absolutelyThe first. But if you don't use wings, that's not necessarily the case. Of course, Sun Yun is also trying to practice flying guns to improve his long-distance combat capabilities.
It is worth mentioning that I got sixteen more Space Stones, which is a good thing. What disappoints Sun Yun is that as Sun Yun gradually develops, refining becomes slower and slower, and it takes a long time to refine a small piece.
Sun Yun has not awakened his talent, but now he behaves more like a human. Wearing clothes made of animal skins, Sun Yun now looks like a robot the size of a three or four year old child. Sometimes Sun Yun feels that talent and strength are slightly related to the direction of hard work and the persistence of what you want.
The Flying Ant Legion, headed by Slender Monkey, has 50,000 warriors; the Gravity Legion, headed by Big Bull, has 50,000 warriors; the Meat Grinder Legion, has 30,000 warriors, Niu Di; the Teeth Army Legion, has 150,000 warriors, Gute; the Flood Legion, has Red Head, with about 400,000 warriors; the Charge Legion, has Crazy Fighter and Baiyu Warriors; the Thunder Team, has Blackhead and 200 warriors; the Guards Xiaoqi and Ah Tai, and two birds.
This is Sun Yun's current strength, and he can barely protect himself in this endless forest and mountains. Now Sun Yun does not plan to increase too much. After all, he is not occupying the top of the mountain. Excessive increase will affect the march. Sun Yun's goal is to find civilization.
